2025

Author: Saurabh Srivastava
Bench: Saurabh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:110423
Court No. - 77

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Mohd. Taufik Ansari
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Yadav,Mohd. Jaid
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application under section 528 Bnss has been preferred to quash the impugned chargesheet
dated 10.07.2023 including the entire proceedings of Case Crime No. 0028 of 2021 (State vs.
Wakeel Ansari and others), under sections 420, 419 I.P.C. and Sections 66, 66-C, 66-D I.T. Act,
Police Station-Cyber Crime Branch Police Thana, District-Prayagraj/Allahabad, pending in the
Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-5, Allahabad as well as to stay the further
proceedings of abovementioned case.
Mohd. Taufik Ansari vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 July, 2025

entities.text: Mohd. Taufik Ansari vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant submitted that he is not pressing the
application on merits and confined his prayer only to the extent that the present application may be
disposed of finally with a direction to the court concerned that in case applicant surrenders before it
and applies for bail, his bail application may be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance
with law, including the law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of
Investigation and another (2022 Scc OnLine Sc 825) to which learned counsel for the respondents
have no objection.

entities.text:
Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of
Investigation and another (2022 Scc OnLine Sc 825)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. In view of the aforesaid, the instant application under section 528 Bnss is finally disposed of with
a direction to the court concerned that in case, the applicant surrenders before the court concerned
within a period of three weeks from today and applies for bail, his bail application shall be
considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with settled law.
5.  However, it is made clear that till three weeks from today, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant herein.

Order Date :- 10.7.2025 #Vik/-
